issues.title: LH004 A historical propagation case
issues.description: Retell the xz backdoor through activity, residue and propagation from the public record, noting which layer carried the first detectable signal and which LH F02 instrument would have recorded it. An essay in the Harbour standard's essay form with an annotated reading list, in studies/LH004/. Done when the essay exists with its reading list.

issues.title: Q-0002 Which model should take which kind of dispatched task?
issues.description: A research note. Compare the models available to the driver, Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, for the kinds of task Lighthouse dispatches: consumer chores such as polling, taking, running commands and posting feedback; collection scripts; source checks; reading surveys; historical essays; study write-ups; and review. For each kind recommend a default model and say why, using published pricing and capability descriptions and the one measured run recorded in CLAUDE.md. State what is not known. Done when notes/Q-0002-model-choices.md exists in the Harbour standard's paper form.

issues.title: E-0001 Edit LH003 into an article
issues.description: E-0001 Edit LH003 into an article. Draft, from studies/LH003/, the article that answers for a reader what we can actually see of AI activity on the internet: what repository activity, model usage reports and crawler measurements each expose, where their populations overlap or differ, and what remains invisible, without pretending the measurements add up to a census. Five minutes to read. Lead with the strongest supported finding and why it matters; keep the qualifications that change its meaning; remove the procedural clutter; name every source as the supplier of its evidence; describe one illustration in words if none can be drawn. Write it to articles/what-we-can-see.md as a draft. Done when the draft exists; release is the keeper's decision under LH F03. This will let us explain what the existing observatories reveal.

issues.title: E-0002 Edit LH004 into an article
issues.description: E-0002 Edit LH004 into an article. Draft, from studies/LH004/, the article that follows the xz backdoor through the structures that carried it: what became visible first, who could see it, and what stayed hidden until later. Five minutes to read, same form as E-0001, every source named as the supplier of its evidence. Write it to articles/the-xz-backdoor.md as a draft. Done when the draft exists; release is the keeper's decision under LH F03. This will let us explain which layer carried a real propagation event and who could have seen it.

issues.title: LH002 A bounded neighbourhood over a historical window
issues.description: LH002 A bounded neighbourhood over a historical window. Follow the design in LH F04's LH002 section: up to ten public repositories from a declared ecosystem, a fixed twenty-eight-day historical window, cohort recorded before analysis, sources S5, S10 and S11 as LH003 surveyed them, identifiers kept out of the published record. The question the observer put: when something changes in this neighbourhood, where does the change appear next? Done when either a pattern is shown with its evidence, or the records are shown unable to connect the events, with the boundary, the window, the sources and the collection dates stated in studies/LH002/. It does not wait for LH001 (D-0003). This will let us establish whether propagation can be read from public records at all.

issues.title: I-0003 Harden the export instrument
issues.description: I-0003 Harden the export instrument. Make harbour/hb export fail on any HTTP error rather than writing an error body into a file, record in the manifest the issue count, whether the dispatch list was truncated, and which files were fetched and which were copied from the session directory, and version the I-0001 record to 0.2 with the change noted as one that affects comparisons. This will let us trust that an export that exists is complete.

issues.title: I-0004 Register LH003's sources as candidate instruments
issues.description: I-0004 Register LH003's sources as candidate instruments. For each source with a row in studies/LH003/sources.md, add a candidate instrument record to registers/instruments.md in the LH F05 form, or one line saying why it is not a candidate, as LH F04's LH003 design asks. This will let us say which outward surfaces Lighthouse could read next and at what cost.

issues.title: LH000 Observe one dispatch end to end
issues.description: Pick a dispatch in this workspace; this one will do. Capture what Harbour records about it, what the host shows while it runs, and what it leaves behind. Write it up with the LH F05 study skeleton in studies/LH000/ and leave unfillable fields blank. Done when the write-up exists and says what could not be filled.

issues.title: I-0001 Register the export as an instrument
issues.description: harbour/hb export already pulls this workspace's issues, dispatches with their feedback, cost, north star and roadmap reports at the end of every session, stamped with a collection time and the Harbour commit. Write its instrument record in registers/instruments.md using the LH F05 form: what it detects, what it misses (the proxy audit log, proxy events, the driver's own tokens), how it was calibrated, its overhead, and the changes that would invalidate comparisons. The weekly cadence applies once Harbour is hosted. Done when the record exists.

issues.title: I-0002 Sample the host
issues.description: A sampler for the machine that claims dispatches: process activity, busy core seconds and requests per destination, at a stated interval, tagged as Lighthouse traffic. Post one sample per dispatch to Harbour as a resources feedback entry. Done when it has captured an idle baseline and one dispatch, with its own overhead measured.

issues.title: Q-0001 Start the question register
issues.description: Enter LH F04's follow-up questions into registers/questions.md with a reason each matters, using the entry form in LH F05. Score nothing yet. Done when the register exists.

issues.title: L-0001 Keep a ledger of cost
issues.description: Cost per study, in registers/ledger.md: the token totals the driver posts in dispatch feedback for each subagent run, Harbour's cost endpoint for its own model calls, and OpenRouter's figures where they exist. Split by whether a person or the autopilot initiated the work. Task counts are not recorded as progress. The driver session's own tokens are not visible from inside it and are entered as unknown. Done when the first session's figures exist.

issues.title: C-0001 Check the sources
issues.description: Fetch every source in LH F02 and note anything that has moved or changed, in a dated entry. Run monthly. Done when the first check has run.

issues.title: LH003 Survey of surveys
issues.description: Reading only. List the observatories that already exist, such as GH Archive, Cloudflare Radar, Software Heritage, Open Source Insights, OpenRouter's rankings and the vulnerability databases, with the layer each sees, its population, boundary, unit, cadence and licence, in studies/LH003/. Done when every candidate has a row or a reason for exclusion.
